# MaxMind test fixture

`GeoIP2-Country-Test.mmdb` is the public synthetic test database from
[maxmind/MaxMind-DB](https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/tree/6a690a705bc6962c0025a32e94a8f0dc8f86418c/test-data),
downloaded on 2026-10-13. This is a format-testing fixture, not a live GeoLite dataset.
It is used to exercise the real MMDB iterator without account credentials or network access.
